GIST.reason: Required clinical covariates and individual event times are absent from the external cohort.

melanoma.reason: No melanoma-specific feature set, weights, endpoint, or development cohort has been frozen.

breast.reason: No PI3K/letrozole score is frozen and NEO-ORB patient-level data are not public.

renal.reason: The published 15G model is not the repository score and IMmotion151 data require controlled access.

pancreas.reason: No PRINCE-like score is frozen; public PRINCE data currently support descriptive arm-level analysis only.

interpretation: Cohort screening is complete; score-level external validation must not begin until a tumor-specific score passes the freeze protocol.
